tokens.v: A SINGLE carton only, alone in frame — disregard any instruction below about multiple containers. It stands firm on weathered orchard wood while halved green apples and oat stalks tumble around it mid-air, one apple half striking the boards and throwing a low crown of juice and pulp, fine mist hanging where it burst. 100mm at f/4, camera at carton height, hard backlight rimming every airborne droplet against a deep orchard-green field, the kraft board's fibre texture sharp. ORCHARD OAT reads letterpressed in large clean capitals; a blurred apple leaf crosses the top-left corner, cut by it.
